description: This Java source file defines the class RetrieveAttributesResponse, which is a response object for the RetrieveAttributes command in an Eclipse Ditto-based system. It includes methods for creating instances from various inputs, handles JSON serialization/deserialization, and provides accessors for the retrieved Thing's ID and Attributes.
